systems.system: guichet electronique unique for foreign-trade authorisations

note: Sigad is named only as the dematerialisation Customs continues, with no statement on declarations; the August 2026 Customs electronic window is for trade authorisations and the text does not say it joins other border agencies; the investment single window is a business one-stop shop.
Document is about land conservation offices, not customs.

facts.fact: CUPIA says it launched ALCES, an automated customs clearance system based on Korea's UNI-PASS, in major customs centres including the Port of Algiers and Algiers airport.

note: Single window is described as underway, targeted March 2024; not in service.
Only the decree's preamble is shown; it sets the rules for a customs single window but states no system in service or being built.

facts.fact: Algeria's customs director general says the new customs information system ALCES, in service since November 2023 at land, sea and air border customs offices, had recorded 168,000 detailed declarations by September 2024, 70% of filings, the rest on the old SIGAD system.

note: Interconnection with ministries under the single window is in trials, not in service.

facts.fact: Finance Minister Abdelkrim Bouzred says the customs information system launched in early November 2023 is generalised to all customs offices, with electronic processing of customs files at all land, sea and air centres, and 23,402 traders registered by end March 2025.

note: A single-window link to ministries is only under way.

facts.fact: Algerian customs' information director said on 26 October 2024 that the new customs information system entered service in November 2023, with the ALCES platform already launched at ports.
TSA Algerie reports that the Algerian customs information system ALCES lets customs formalities be done online.

TSA Algerie reports a customs notice of 18 August 2026 saying the electronic single window module of ALCES was put in service, with Commerce Ministry authorisations now filed through it in parallel with paper and several other bodies to be covered.

systems.country_label: ALCES customs information system with electronic single window module

facts.fact: Algerian customs' new information system ALCES, launched in November 2023, handles electronic declarations and electronic clearance.

note: Database record only; system claim held, portal line is an online services portal, not a single window.
